description: Follow earthquakes in Italy and the Mediterranean from INGV, the national institute whose seismic network makes Italy's official earthquake catalogue. Search it by time, magnitude, depth and area, get the latest earthquakes in Italy or those near a place, and count them by magnitude for a period. Look one up with every location and magnitude INGV made, including the local magnitude (ML) it gives even the smallest, and how the fault moved for larger ones. Each earthquake is placed by its nearest town; see the towns around it and how many people live there, the municipality, province and region of any point, and INGV's seismic stations. A trigger starts a workflow for each new earthquake. No account or API key required.
